rationale: The tape shows a steady idiosyncratic bleed — price sits 0.43% above the session low, below both the 5m VWAP ($30.63) and 9-EMA ($30.23), with marginal new lows into the close against a SPY up 0.89% — which leans slightly short, but with only 8 minutes left, a ~$0.06 5-min ATR implies an expected move of barely $0.04–0.06 versus ~$0.02 spread plus slippage, leaving almost no edge after costs. There is also no reversal or acceleration trigger: volume is fading on the breakdown candles, so neither a low-reversion bounce (long) nor a flush continuation (short) has confirmable momentum. Forcing either side here is roughly a coin flip after transaction drag, so standing flat into the close is the highest-expectancy action.
